author: Mark Atwood
text:
Rescoped 2026-05-13 per Mark's Option-A decision.

Scope reduced from full 12-variant matrix + 4 permission gates + ULID assertions + cascade tests → single kitchen-sink smoke test exercising all 12 ops in one /set call as an admin caller (~80 LOC).

Three follow-up beads filed under JMAP-g7wu.2.4 for the items that were out of scope of the existing impl beads:

  * JMAP-g7wu.2.4.13 (P2, autonomous) — manage_space gate on top-level Space metadata patches
  * JMAP-g7wu.2.4.14 (P2, autonomous) — manage_channels gate on Channel/Category ops in apply_space_patch
  * JMAP-g7wu.2.4.15 (P3, human-decision) — MemoryBackend next_id: sequential vs ULIDs design question

Removing 'human' label. The kitchen-sink test is straightforward autonomous work; /do-beads can claim it.
